Algebra Q=-1/(1+h),h≠0,-1; denominator tends to1, giving limit-1. Finite rounded rows alone prove neither existence nor value.
Exact binomial expansion:(x+h)^3-x^3=3x²h+3xh²+h³; divide by h≠0 then take h→0 to obtain3x². Numeric checks corroborate, not replace, the identity.
Common-denominator identity gives-1/[x(x+h)] with x≠0,h≠0,x+h≠0; limit -x^-2. This proves n=-1 only, not all integers.

A consistent smooth witness has position12m and instantaneous rate-2m/s at3s. Rate is signed coordinate change; no constant interval velocity follows.
